name: How long does a typical flooring replacement project take?
description: Project duration depends on area size, flooring type, and preparation. Small projects can take days, larger ones a week or more.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical flooring replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a flooring replacement project varies based on the size of the area, the type of flooring being installed, and the amount of preparation required. Small projects, such as a single room, might take a few days, while larger whole-home replacements could extend to a week or more. Existing flooring removal and subfloor repairs can also add to the timeline.
